Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- feat: Kadget 3.7.0 / Kadget Remote 1.7.0 — WebRTC screen, input and mirror; protocol doc; remote tracks always come with a stream
- feat(remote-app): WebRTC screen view with input on a data channel, WebRTC phone mirror, ICE servers from Kadget Cloud; JPEG frames stay as the fallback
